COLINSPATCHKIT-SHOW_CURRENT_NODE_TOOLTIP: Show tooltip on current map node
Show the room-history tooltip when hovering over the map node you are currently on, instead of only on previously visited nodes.
COLINSPATCHKIT-SHOW_MAP_NODE_INFO_TOOLTI: Show info tooltips on upcoming map nodes

Hovering an upcoming (not-yet-visited) map node shows a tooltip summarising what that room type is worth — wiki-level info only, never the actual outcome of that specific node. Unknown nodes show the live room distribution, elites list the act's possible elites plus your potion chance, enemies show your potion chance, chests show the gold range, merchants show approximate prices, and rest sites show how much you would heal.
COLINSPATCHKIT-SHOW_WELL_LAID_PLANS_RETA: Show retain slots for Well Laid Plans
When choosing cards to Retain with Well Laid Plans, show one dotted card outline per retain slot so it is obvious how many cards can still be picked. Selected cards fill the slots left to right.
COLINSPATCHKIT-SORT_CURSES_AND_STATUSES_: When choosing a card from your draw pile to exhaust (Cleanse) or transform into a specific card (Charge, Seance), list curses first, then statuses, then everything else, so the cards you usually want to get rid of are easy to find. Vanilla sorts them to the very bottom. Other draw-pile choices like Wish, and the deck view, are unaffected.
COLINSPATCHKIT-SKIP_INTRO_LOGO.title: Skip intro Mega Crit logo
COLINSPATCHKIT-SKIP_INTRO_LOGO.hover.des: Skip the Mega Crit logo animation at startup and go straight to the main menu.
COLINSPATCHKIT-SKIP_GAME_OVER_ANIMATIONS: On the run-summary screen shown when a run ends, click (or press confirm) to fast-forward the score lines and badges as they are revealed one at a time. Each click snaps the current line fully into place and removes the remaining pauses between sections, so a few clicks jump straight to the Return to Main Menu button instead of waiting out the animations.
COLINSPATCHKIT-MAKE_ETHEREAL_CARDS_TRANS: Render the colored frame of Ethereal cards slightly transparent so they are easy to spot at a glance. Card text, art and icons stay fully opaque.
COLINSPATCHKIT-SHOW_RELIC_READY_PULSES.t: Pulse relics while their effect is ready
COLINSPATCHKIT-SHOW_RELIC_READY_PULSES.h: Some relics with once-per-turn or once-per-combat effects give no hint whether the effect is still available. Show the same pulsing glow used by relics like Vambrace while the effect is ready. Applies to Permafrost, Centennial Puzzle, Ruined Helmet, Lava Lamp, Demon Tongue, Mini Regent and Music Box.
COLINSPATCHKIT-SHOW_POWER_READY_PULSES.t: Pulse buffs/debuffs while their effect is ready
COLINSPATCHKIT-SHOW_POWER_READY_PULSES.h: Pulse power icons the way Escape Artist pulses when its effect is imminent: first-each-turn effects (Echo Form, Iteration, Nostalgia, Phantom Blades, Lethality, Unmovable, Pale Blue Dot, Smoggy) while still available, counters (Juggling, Orbit, Automation, Panache, Outbreak, Withering Presence) when one step from triggering, countdowns (The Bomb, Asleep, Slumber, Hatch) when they fire after this turn, and end-of-turn damage debuffs (Constrict, Disintegration) as a constant reminder to block.
COLINSPATCHKIT-MATCH_COMPENDIUM_MULTIPLA: Match Compendium multiplayer cards to run

When opening the Compendium's card library during a run, default the "Multiplayer cards" toggle to on in multiplayer runs and off in singleplayer runs, instead of always on. Outside a run the toggle keeps its vanilla always-on default.
COLINSPATCHKIT-MOVE_SHOP_HAND_AWAY_FASTE: When you stop hovering over a shop item, the merchant's pointing hand returns to its resting spot after a brief moment (0.3s) instead of lingering over the wares for two seconds. Moving between items keeps the hand pointing. The pointing gesture after a purchase is unchanged.
COLINSPATCHKIT-SHOW_CARD_REWARD_VIEW_UPG: Show View Upgrades toggle on card rewards

Add the deck view's "View Upgrades" toggle to the card reward screen and to the Scroll Boxes choose-a-pack screen, so reward cards can be previewed in their upgraded form before picking. Mouse only; hidden while playing with a controller, like the deck view's toggle.
COLINSPATCHKIT-SKIP_RETURNED_CARD_PREVIE: Send returned reward cards straight to deck

When you take a special card reward — the card the Thieving Hopper stole and hands back, or the Lantern Key event's card — it normally floats in the center of the screen for two seconds, hiding the card behind it (such as the middle card on the reward screen). Send it straight to your deck instead, like a normal card reward.
COLINSPATCHKIT-EXCLUDE_CHARACTERS_FROM_R: Ban characters from the Random pick

With Random selected on the character select screen, right-click a character to ban it from the Random pick; right-click again to unban. Embarking as Random then rolls only among the characters you haven't banned. In multiplayer, only your own pick is affected.
